description: Sync the meetings booked through Calendly in your organization, one searchable document per meeting with its invitees and booking answers.
opening: Sync the meetings booked through Calendly in one organization. Each scheduled meeting is one document that combines its time, location, hosts and guests with the event type's description and every invitee's booking-form answers and cancellation reasons.

Calendly permissions are not imported, so every synced meeting is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Canceled meetings stay in HydraDB, marked canceled, with their cancellation reasons. A change to only an invitee or an event type does not update a meeting's document until the meeting itself changes.

connect.auth: Calendly uses a personal access token and your organization's Calendly API URI.

credentials.name: organization_url
credentials.text: Your organization's Calendly API URI, in the form `https://api.calendly.com/organizations/<uuid>/`. It limits the sync to that organization.

steps.title: Create a personal access token
steps.text: Create a Calendly personal access token.

steps.title: Find your organization URI
steps.text: Find your own organization's API URI, in the form `https://api.calendly.com/organizations/<uuid>/`.

steps.title: Create the connector
steps.text: Paste the token as `auth_token` and the URI as `organization_url`.

steps.title: Select the organization
steps.text: HydraDB lists one item for the whole organization. Select it. You cannot pick individual meetings.

connect.account: One connector reads one Calendly organization.

sync.first_sync: Reads meetings updated within the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default. Meetings with no update time are read regardless.
sync.changes: Each sync reads the meetings, invitees and event types updated since the last sync.
sync.edits: A meeting whose update time changes is read again and rebuilt with its current event type and invitees. A change to only an invitee or an event type does not update the meeting's document until the meeting itself changes.
sync.deletes: A canceled meeting stays in HydraDB with its status and any cancellation reasons. Meetings deleted in Calendly stay searchable in HydraDB.

documents.name: Meetings
documents.one_document: One scheduled meeting, with its invitees.
documents.title: The meeting name, or `Calendly event <uri>` when it has none.
documents.text: The meeting name, a `Status` line, a `When` line with the start and end, a `Location` line, `Hosts` and `Guests` lines, and the event type's description. Then each invitee with name or email, status, cancellation reason and answered booking questions, then the meeting notes. The event type's name appears only when it has a description. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the meeting was last updated, else when it starts.
documents.link_back: The meeting's join link, such as a Zoom or Google Meet link, not a Calendly page. It can be empty, for example for an in-person meeting.

attributes.name: start_time
attributes.text: When the meeting starts, written in the `When` line. Sets the result date when the meeting has no update time.

attributes.name: end_time
attributes.text: When the meeting ends, written after the start in the `When` line when there is a start.

attributes.name: hosts
attributes.text: Host names, or emails when there is no name, written as the `Hosts` line. Hosts are not attached to the meeting as people in the graph.

attributes.name: location
attributes.text: The location type, such as `zoom` or `physical`, written as the `Location` line.

attributes.name: join_url
attributes.text: The join link. Used as the link back, and written in the `Location` line when the meeting has a location type.

attributes.name: event_type_name
attributes.text: The event type's name, written before its description when the description is not empty. To limit a query to one event type, filter on `additional_metadata.container_name`.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.text: When the meeting was last updated. Sets the result date and decides which meetings each sync reads. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.calendly_uri
attributes.text: The meeting's Calendly API URI. Picks out one meeting. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.container_id
attributes.text: The event type's URI, also kept as `event_type`. Limits a query to meetings of one event type. It does not link meetings together. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.container_name
attributes.text: The event type's name. Limits a query to an event type by name. Not searchable under this key.

attributes.name: connector_id
attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's meetings. Not searchable.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the meeting was booked, as distinct from when it takes place.

attributes.name: invitee_count
attributes.text: How many invitees with a name or email were found when the document was built.

example_searches: Who booked a demo with us this week and what did they say they need?
Why did invitees cancel their onboarding calls last month?
Which meetings are booked under the Intro call event type?

graph.connections: No links between meetings or to other tools. The event type is a query filter, not a link.
graph.people: The connector does not attach hosts, guests or invitees to a meeting as people. Their names and emails are part of the meeting text.
graph.from_text: The whole meeting text, including who booked, their booking answers and why they cancelled.

not_synced: Routing forms, organization memberships and user records.
Event types and bookings as documents of their own.
Meetings last updated before the first sync's window.
Deletions: meetings deleted in Calendly stay in HydraDB.
